unit: growth in job postings, late 2022 to early 2026
title: Demand for the people who keep data centers running
subtitle: Job-posting growth, not headcount or wages. The low bars are the baseline that makes the high ones credible.
caption: The memo's original phrasing put the 51% floor on HVAC engineers; Randstad's release puts it on industrial automation technicians, with HVAC at 67%. Posting growth measures demand and can rise from expansion, churn or re-posting, so it is a signal rather than a shortage count.
source: Randstad press release, March 18, 2026, from more than 50 million job postings since late 2022.
